tax.text: Marques says he will reduce taxes so Alabamians keep more of their earnings.
tax.quote: put more of your hard-earned money back in your pocket so hardworking Alabamians will prosper like never before.

immigration.text: Marques says he would support detaining and deporting criminal undocumented immigrants and ending mass migration.
immigration.quote: As your Congressman, I'll fight to keep criminal illegal aliens out of our communities and end the mass migration madness that's driven down American wages and undermined our working class.

guns.text: Marques frames gun ownership as a God-given right guaranteed by the Second Amendment that he will protect.
guns.quote: The right to protect ourselves and our loved ones is God-given and guaranteed by the Second Amendment.

abortion.text: Marques says he voted for a strong anti-abortion law and will oppose abortion-rights measures in Congress.
abortion.quote: I voted for the strongest pro-life law in our country, and I'll fight Democrats' radical, pro-abortion agenda in Washington.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Marques says he would bar transgender women from girls' locker rooms.
gender.quote: kick biological men out of our girls' locker rooms.

trade.text: Voted against extending government funding in part because he said tariffs raise the prices consumers pay for imported goods.
trade.quote: You raised tariffs on the price of goods that are coming from other countries.

abortion.text: Figures pledged to protect abortion rights and contraception access, saying women should be able to make these decisions themselves.
abortion.quote: Going back to an era where women had that reproductive choice, that freedom is where we need to be

health.text: Figures spoke on the House floor against Republican plans to cut Medicaid and SNAP and has pushed to expand Medicaid in Alabama.
health.quote: Today, Rep. Shomari C. Figures (AL-02) spoke on the House Floor to oppose the Republicans' plan to significantly cut Medicaid and SNAP benefits for millions of Americans
